The Olmic Rune#000.src: It has no fuel left, maybe you can start it again?
The Olmic Rune#000.dst: No le queda combustible, ¿quizá puedas volver a arrancarla?

The Olmic Rune#001.src: The crystalized magic on the floor seems unstable. Maybe something can shatter it...
The Olmic Rune#001.dst: La magia cristalizada del suelo parece inestable. Quizá algo pueda hacerla añicos...

The Olmic Rune#003.src: The strange shard is reacting to the floor...
The Olmic Rune#003.dst: El extraño fragmento reacciona al suelo...

The Olmic Rune#005.src: Head back to the machine at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Olmic Rune#007.src: The loud noise is bound to attract creatures of the expanse.
The Olmic Rune#007.dst: Semejante estruendo atraerá sin duda a las criaturas del Expanse.

The Olmic Rune#008.src: It looks like the machine is about to break through!
The Olmic Rune#008.dst: ¡Parece que la máquina está a punto de atravesarlo!

The Olmic Rune#009.src: Find some sort of fuel in the Ruined City.
The Olmic Rune#009.dst: Encuentra algún tipo de combustible en Ruined City.

The Olmic Rune#010.src: Find some sort of fuel in the ruined city
The Olmic Rune#010.dst: Encuentra algún tipo de combustible en la ciudad en ruinas

The Olmic Rune#011.src: Explore the cave for the fuel
The Olmic Rune#011.dst: Explora la cueva en busca del combustible

The Olmic Rune#012.src: Collect [{~} Fuel Sprites] and bring it back to the machine.
The Olmic Rune#012.dst: Reúne [{~} Espíritus de combustible] y llévalos de vuelta a la máquina.

The Olmic Rune#013.src: Defend the machine from the incoming attackers.
The Olmic Rune#013.dst: Defiende la máquina de los atacantes que llegan.

The Olmic Rune#015.src: Now that you have enough fuel, you should return to the machine.
The Olmic Rune#015.dst: Ahora que tienes suficiente combustible, deberías volver a la máquina.

The Olmic Rune#016.src: It looks like a mining machine that's hundreds of years old. What was it mining though?
The Olmic Rune#016.dst: Parece una máquina minera de hace cientos de años. Pero ¿qué extraía?

The Olmic Rune#017.src: {#} You get the feeling you shouldn't be here...
The Olmic Rune#017.dst: {#} Tienes la sensación de que no deberías estar aquí...

The Olmic Rune#018.src: It's a strangely shaped keyhole. How cryptic.
The Olmic Rune#018.dst: Es una cerradura con una forma extraña. Qué críptico.
